name: A Sandusky shore lot

place_source.title: Wikidata: Sandusky, Ohio (Q608207), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A suburban lot on the low shore of Sandusky Bay, Lake Erie: lawn to the road, white cedar and redcedar along the back fence, a buckeye and a serviceberry in the middle, and the water a few steps past the end of the drive, where herons and gulls work the shallows, a fox squirrel runs the oak line, and raccoons and a bat come in off the beach after dark.

facts.text: Sandusky has a humid continental climate (Köppen Dfa), typical of the Midwestern United States, with warm summers and cold winters.

source.title: Wikipedia: Sandusky, Ohio

facts.text: Sandusky sits on the southern shore of Lake Erie at the head of Sandusky Bay, and averages 23.3 inches (59 cm) of snow a winter.

source.title: Wikipedia: Sandusky, Ohio
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Sandusky, Ohio", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The city had 25,095 residents at the 2020 census, and the Sandusky metropolitan area 115,986.

facts.text: Ohio is red-winged blackbird country: a Wood County study of 1964-1968 found territorial males at 2.89 times the density in wetland habitat as in upland.

source.title: Wikipedia: Red-winged blackbird

facts.text: Eastern fox squirrels in Ohio rank their food: white oak acorns first, then black oak acorns, red oak acorns, walnuts, and corn.

facts.text: The Lake Erie watersnake, which lives mainly on the islands offshore from Ohio, came off the US endangered species list in 2011 after it recovered.
